data.name: CLI user
data.Description: The person who runs the scan or export command in a terminal.

data.name: API-equivalent cost
data.Definition: What the recorded token usage would have cost at published list prices. Both renderers show it as the headline figure.

data.name: Report
data.Definition: The computed usage and cost object that both renderers read: totals, buckets by model, client, provider, project and day, a daily series, unknown models and warnings.

data.name: Prompt caching savings
data.Definition: The difference between the cost without caching and the cost with it, shown only when positive.

data.name: Unpriced model
data.Definition: A model with no rate in the rates table. Its tokens are listed but excluded from totals.

data.name: Print a usage and cost summary in the terminal
data.Description: A user runs the scan command and reads the headline cost and one breakdown table as text.
data.Preconditions: Usage was found: the scan command exits with code 1 and a hint when the report has no events.
data.Postconditions: The terminal shows a Total panel, one table for the chosen grouping, and the unpriced and warning notices when they apply.
Main flow: 1. The user runs scan; the command builds the report and, when --json is not set, passes it to the terminal renderer. `src/ai_usage_cost/cli.py:105`
2. The renderer prints the Total panel with cost, tokens, requests, sessions, date span, log file count and rates date. `src/ai_usage_cost/render/terminal.py:20`
3. It picks the table for the requested grouping and prints it when the bucket list is not empty. `src/ai_usage_cost/render/terminal.py:29`
4. It lists unpriced models and tells the user to add them to rates.json. `src/ai_usage_cost/render/terminal.py:40`
5. It prints every warning when verbose, otherwise only a count. `src/ai_usage_cost/render/terminal.py:46`
data.Alternative flows:
Step 3 alt: an unknown grouping name falls back to the model table. `src/ai_usage_cost/render/terminal.py:29`
Start alt: no events found, the command prints a notice and exits with code 1. `src/ai_usage_cost/cli.py:104`
data.Acceptance criteria: The headline shows a prompt caching saving line only when the saving is above zero. `src/ai_usage_cost/render/terminal.py:62`

data.name: Export a usage and cost chart as a PNG image
data.Description: A user runs the export command with a .png output path and receives a four panel chart of the report.
data.Preconditions: The output file name ends in .png.
data.Postconditions: An image file exists at the output path and the command prints its path.
Main flow: 1. The user runs export with a path; the command builds the report and checks the file extension. `src/ai_usage_cost/cli.py:186`
2. For .png it calls the picture writer. `src/ai_usage_cost/cli.py:192`
3. The writer sets a title with cost, tokens and requests and draws cost per day, cost by model, token mix and cost by project. `src/ai_usage_cost/render/png.py:26`
4. It creates the parent folder and saves the figure, then closes it. `src/ai_usage_cost/render/png.py:32`
data.Alternative flows: Step 1 alt: an extension other than .json or .png prints an error and exits with code 2. `src/ai_usage_cost/cli.py:56`
data.Acceptance criteria: The chart is written with the Agg backend, so no display is needed. `src/ai_usage_cost/render/png.py:9`

data.name: Terminal table shows at most 30 rows
data.Statement: The terminal breakdown table prints only the first 30 buckets, with no notice that rows were cut.

data.name: Day breakdown is listed oldest first
data.Statement: Only the day grouping is sorted ascending by key; every other grouping keeps the order of the report.

data.name: Unknown grouping falls back to model
data.Statement: A grouping name that is not model, client, provider, project or day is treated as model.

data.name: Warnings are summarised unless verbose
data.Statement: Without the verbose flag the terminal shows only the number of warnings.

data.name: Unpriced models are shown but not totalled
data.Statement: Models without a rate appear in their own table and are described as excluded from totals.

data.name: PNG charts are limited to the top buckets
data.Statement: The model cost chart and project cost chart show at most 10 buckets and the token mix chart at most 8 models.

data.name: Empty project panel is left blank
data.Statement: When the report has no project buckets the project chart panel is switched off instead of drawn.

data.name: Export accepts only json and png
data.Statement: The export command refuses any other extension with exit code 2.

data.name: PNG export runs without a display
data.Statement: The picture writer selects the non interactive Agg backend before importing pyplot.

data.name: Render layer has no tests of its own
data.Risk: No test file imports or lives inside the render folder, so output format changes are not caught here.
data.Mitigation: Add tests for the headline text, the 30 row cut and the empty project panel.

data.name: Silent row truncation in terminal tables
data.Risk: Only 30 rows are printed and nothing tells the user that more exist.
data.Mitigation: Print a note when buckets are cut.

data.name: Where is the dashboard data produced
data.Question: The brief for this chunk mentions data for the local dashboard, but the render folder holds only terminal.py and png.py. The dashboard reads the report from the HTTP route in src/ai_usage_cost/api.py. Is the dashboard payload meant to belong to another chunk?

data.name: Does the PNG chart need a group by option
data.Question: write_png always charts model, project, day and token mix and ignores the grouping the user chose in scan. Is that intended?
